title: High-Protein Paneer Roti

ingredients.as_written: 150g soft low fat paneer (homemade) (Comment “paneer” for the recipe to get it in your dms)

steps: Crush/grate paneer and add 2 tbsp flour. Start kneading the dough and then add 1-2 tbsp of flour again.
It will take you 6-7 mins to make the dough soft and well combined. Absolutely no water is required to knead this dough as homemade paneer reatins a little water.
Divide the dough into equal balls and start rolling into rotis.
Cook them like normal rotis on a tawa and cook on low flame.
Apply some ghee on your rotis once off the flame and enjoy with sabzis/curries.
MOST IMPORTANT TIP - Apply oil on your rolling board so that this roti does not tear apart while rolling.
